final: WITH per AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG(rebrate * 1.0 / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per) SELECT per.orderslink, per.avg_rebtotal, per.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN per.avg_ratio / m.mean_ratio END AS relative_ratio FROM per, m ORDER BY (CASE WHEN m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN per.avg_ratio / m.mean_ratio END) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
